headword: {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}
gloss: drawing power; ability to attract customers

definitions.gloss: drawing power; ability to attract customers; crowd-pulling ability
definitions.explanation: The capacity of a business, event, location, or person to attract large numbers of customers or visitors. A key metric in marketing and business planning.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This event has strong drawing power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Shops in front of the station have strong customer-drawing power.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}して→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧{集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to use social media to increase your ability to attract customers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{集客|しゅうきゃく}→集客：18040_shuukyaku⟧ (attracting customers) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). A common business and marketing term. The suffix {力|りょく} is productive and attaches to many nouns to express "ability" or "power" in that area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to increase drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧: improvement of drawing power
- {集客力|しゅうきゃくりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to lose drawing power

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{集客|しゅうきゃく}→集客：18040_shuukyaku⟧: attracting customers
- {動員力|どういんりょく}: mobilization power (similar concept for events)
- {吸引力|きゅういんりょく}: attraction, pulling power (more general)
